search_difficulty_note: Hard slot, mainly on the electrical gate and the copy gate. Snippets almost never state plug type, voltage or CE, so every lead needs a page check for all three; some are LED-integrated units (not E27), and many are hard-wired. Most AliExpress results are LED/USB bedside reading lamps, gooseneck or industrial swing arms (all off-style). No CJ or Spocket wall-sconce single-product page was found (CJ results were night lights/bedside lamps only; Spocket none). REJECTED at search stage: 'Modern Marseille Wall Lamp White Black Metal Swing Arm Sconce' (aliexpress.us/item/3256803235739923.html), a Nemo Lampe de Marseille style copy; bronze/gold gooseneck and double-head sconces (forbidden). 6-7 leads, not padded.
